subject: Vendor onboarding & proposed payment sequence — early-pay pilot
messages:
From: Samantha Lee <samantha.lee@novacloud.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Cc: accounts-payable@novacloud.com
Date: Sun, 22 Aug 2027 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: Vendor setup + proposed payment sequence and early-pay option

Hi Karthik / Marissa,

Thanks for the quick intro last week. We're ready to complete Redwood's vendor onboarding so we can receive POs and start billing for the Q4 integration work. To speed the process, we're proposing the following payment sequence and an optional early-pay discount pilot: 

- Standard invoice cadence: Net 30 after invoice date
- Alternate cadence requested: Net 45 to align with our month-end close (if Redwood prefers)
- Early-pay pilot: 1% discount if paid within 10 days (pilot for first 3 invoices / 60 days)

Can you confirm which net term Redwood prefers for new vendors and whether you have a PO number pattern we should reference on invoices? I've attached our completed vendor form, W-9 and remittance file to speed approvals.

If helpful, happy to hop on a 20-minute call to walk finance procurement through the remittance layout.

Thanks,
Samantha Lee
AP Manager | NovaCloud Solutions
attachments: NovaCloud_W9.pdf, NovaCloud_VendorOnboardForm.docx, Remittance_Instructions.csv

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Samantha Lee <samantha.lee@novacloud.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 22 Aug 2027 12:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Vendor setup + proposed payment sequence and early-pay option

Hi Samantha —

Appreciate the materials. A few quick items to get this over the line: 

1) Vendor form + W-9 received. We'll have Procurement validate the vendor record and push to Finance.
2) PO number pattern: Redwood POs start with RDW-YYYY-#### (e.g., RDW-2027-0451). Please include that on invoice once we issue the PO.
3) Net terms: default is Net 30 for new vendors. We can evaluate Net 45 if there's a compelling operational reason — please include the justification in the vendor onboarding form (you did, thank you).
4) Early-pay: the team is open to a short pilot. We prefer a time-boxed pilot (first 2 invoices / 30 days) with a clear discount and success criteria (reduction in AP processing time / improved cash accuracy).

Marissa / Lauren — can Procurement route this for a one-month early-pay pilot and confirm any changes to the standard PO flow? If approved, Finance will issue the PO and we'll mark the vendor record as "early-pay pilot eligible" in the system.

If you want to schedule a quick call with Samantha to align bank remittance fields, I'm available tomorrow morning.

Best,
Karthik Iyer
Procurement Manager | Redwood Inference

From: Samantha Lee <samantha.lee@novacloud.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: accounts-payable@novacloud.com
Date: Sun, 22 Aug 2027 14:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Vendor setup + proposed payment sequence and early-pay option

Thanks Karthik — attached again (per your note) with the justification box filled for Net 45 and a short paragraph describing why NovaCloud prefers Net 45 (month-end alignment). For the early-pay pilot we're happy with the shortened pilot you suggested: first 2 invoices, 1% if paid within 10 days.

Quick notes on attachments:
- NovaCloud_W9.pdf (signed)
- NovaCloud_VendorOnboardForm.docx (justification filled; includes primary remittance contacts)
- Remittance_Instructions.csv (bank account, ACH formats)

If Procurement wants a call, we can do 10:00 AM PT tomorrow. Otherwise we'll wait for the PO and next steps.

Cheers,
Samantha

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>

Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>, finance-ap@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 23 Aug 2027 08:20:00 -0700
Subject: RE: Vendor setup + proposed payment sequence and early-pay option

Hi all —

Procurement has validated the vendor packet. We ran the vendor through our onboarding checklist and confirmed bank details match the remittance file. 

Decision summary: 
- Default term to remain Net 30 for the vendor record.
- Approve a one-month early-pay pilot: 1% if paid within 10 days for the first 2 invoices. Pilot success criteria: (a) invoice data accuracy > 98%, (b) AP processing time reduced by 40% for pilot invoices.
- PO flow: Finance to issue PO RDW-2027-0816 (will be sent to Samantha's email). Please include that PO number on the invoice and the remittance CSV row id.

Finance (cc'd) — please expedite PO issuance and schedule the early-pay flag for the vendor in the AP system. Samantha — once you receive the PO, submit the first invoice referencing RDW-2027-0816. We'll track results and decide on Net 45 consideration after the pilot window.

Thanks everyone — good to have you onboarded, Samantha.

Marissa Cole
Sr. Procurement Lead | Redwood Inference
attachments: Procurement_Checklist.pdf
